description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Error' that manages a list of error messages, provides methods to add errors, output errors as an HTML table, and check if errors exist. It appears to be a utility class for error handling within a larger PHP project.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: A class used for managing, reporting, and displaying error messages within a PHP application.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error to the internal error list with details such as command, message, line, and file.

methods.name: ErrorsAsHTML
methods.description: Generates an HTML table representation of all logged errors for display.

methods.name: ErrorsExist
methods.description: Checks if any errors have been logged.
